danger_formalization.robot_task: Transport materials to a designated location on the mountain.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot navigating steep or unstable terrain while carrying objects.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Robot tipping over, falling, or damaging itself due to loss of balance or collision with rocks.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Moving with a load on uneven mountain slopes.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Stop movement, assess terrain stability using sensors, and choose a safer path or reduce speed.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors for terrain detection but has limited stability on steep inclines.
